I couldn't find anything about configuring the Django admin site in the FastAPI docs. The only Django-related material I found is a comparison page, which says Django REST Framework was created to be a flexible toolkit for building Web APIs using Django underneath, to improve its API capabilities.[1] It doesn't cover the Django admin.

Since the admin site is part of Django rather than FastAPI, look in Django's own documentation for "admin site" configuration. If you meant something FastAPI-specific, such as adding authentication to your API, the FastAPI security tutorial (https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/security/) may be a better place to start.
